recommendation: Keep the source fix. If Patient Care wants Condition.recorder to influence compartment membership, handle that as a separate compartment-specific Jira rather than inferring it from this search-parameter reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-34479 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. The request was to make Condition.recorder searchable and includable; after FHIR-34395 merged recorder and asserter into Condition.participant, the approved application was to rename participant to participant-actor and add participant-function.
initial_application: The Jira was initially applied by e56aa443ee, which changed the Condition search parameter source from participant to participant-actor and added participant-function. No separate recorder SearchParameter was added because participant.actor carried recorder-like actors in the then-current model.
additional_context: FHIR-39602 later applied an R6 decision to replace Condition.participant with explicit Condition.recorder and Condition.asserter. Its implementation commented out participant-actor and participant-function and restored only Condition-asserter, leaving the active Condition.recorder element without the recorder search surface requested by FHIR-34479. Condition remains active in source/fhir.ini. Confluence minutes show FHIR-34479 on the Patient Care agenda, and no Zulip search found a conflicting later rationale.
reconciliation: Added a normative Condition-recorder reference SearchParameter to source/condition/bundle-Condition-search-params.xml with expression Condition.recorder. No compartment entries were changed because the decided request was about search/_include behavior, and no reviewed decision was found directing a recorder compartment membership change.
source_changes: source/condition/bundle-Condition-search-params.xml: added Condition-recorder reference SearchParameter with expression Condition.recorder.

related_jiras.note: Merged Condition.recorder and Condition.asserter into Condition.participant, shaping the original participant-based application of FHIR-34479.
Reverted Condition.participant back to Condition.recorder and Condition.asserter for R6, which removed the active participant search parameters that had satisfied FHIR-34479.
A later Resolved - No Change issue about Condition compartment wording confirmed compartment tables reference search parameter names; it did not direct adding Condition.recorder to compartments.
